name: Forrest Tucker (career bank robber and prison escaper, 1920-2004), silhouette only
depiction: Real convicted person, deceased (died in federal custody, May 2004). Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette: no face, no features, no likeness; a slim older man's outline (a plain work shirt in the 1979 scenes, a plain suit and a generic brimmed hat in 1999). No weapon is ever drawn; no teller is shown threatened. Tagged ILLUSTRATION · NOT A LIKENESS.
